holderQuote: I have a bag full of wealth beyond Durene’s imagination.
I can feel an…intensity in my gaze. Something stronger, frightening. A Skill. [Intimidating Glare].
effectQuote: The bear whines. It’s not aggressive.

holderQuote: The nerve. I’m fighting not to open my eyes and use [Intimidating Glare]—or punch her at this point.
Fierce, glaring…it doesn’t matter. I don’t bother to use [Intimidating Glare]; there’s no point. I can show these people that I can stand up for myself without a Skill.
